messages:
jessica (oncall): Incidentbot page: SEV-2 - Myrion dedicated pool - canary artifact causing 5xxs and 300-500ms latency spikes for tenant myrion. Observed ~2026-03-10T18:12Z. https://dash.redwood/inc/3895 :rotating_light:
incidentbot: [ALERT] myrion.dedicated.canary - 5xx_rate > 4% for 10m. pinned_artifact=art-20260310-37a9c
omar (sre): I'm on it. grabbing logs from the canary slice now. tagging @eli-platform for artifact ops.
eli-platform: looking. quick summary pls: is this traffic for 100% of myrion or just canary subset?
jessica (oncall): Can confirm only canary subset (10% of myrion traffic) hit. Customer-facing calls from @mike-myrion reporting degraded responses.
mike-myrion: Seeing lots of timeout errors in our ingestion path. Some requests return truncated outputs. We're holding customer calls, need ETA.
omar (sre): attaching recent pod logs:
```
2026-03-10T18:09:12Z model-server[pid=2187] WARN kv-cache miss seq=1024
2026-03-10T18:09:13Z model-server[pid=2187] ERROR token-gen failed: oom-ish while matmul
2026-03-10T18:11:45Z http-handler ERROR 500 GET /v1/invoke tenant=myrion artifact=art-20260310-37a9c
```
eli-platform: artifact art-20260310-37a9c was promoted from staging this morning with an optimized kernel. suspect regression under longer contexts.
deploy-bot: canary rollout record -> artifact=art-20260310-37a9c, slice=myrion-canary-1, started_by=ci/cd, start_ts=2026-03-10T17:55Z
nina-cs: Customer impact: sessions dropped ~4.3% over last 15m; top customers at risk: Myrion internal QA + two enterprise tenants. cs has prepped templated message.
jessica (oncall): decision point - do we unanchor/pinback to previous artifact (art-20260228-9f2b1) or isolate tenant and pause canary? We need quick mitigation to stop 5xxs.
sam-solutions: Recommend surgical unanchor: remove new artifact from canary slice and pin previous stable artifact for myrion slice, then monitor. That keeps other tenants unaffected.
omar (sre): I can run the revert. Command I'll use (redwoodctl):
```
# remove artifact from canary
redwoodctl rollout set --tenant myrion --slice myrion-canary-1 --artifact art-20260228-9f2b1 --force --reason "surgical-unanchor due to canary 5xx spike"
redwoodctl cache flush --tenant myrion --scope kv
```
eli-platform: Also prepare kernel fallback: if we unanchor we should set runtime flag to prefer generic matmul path to avoid OOMs:
```
redwoodctl runtime annotate --cluster canary --set runtime.matmul_path=generic
```
jessica (oncall): Omar, you have the lead. Nina, coordinate comms with Myrion (cc Mike). Eli, stand by for rollback ops.
omar (sre): executing now.
deploy-bot: action started: rollback-request by omar at 2026-03-10T18:22:05Z
omar (sre): applied pin -> art-20260228-9f2b1 to myrion-canary-1. flushed kv caches.
elapsed: 00:02
omar (sre): throwing quick traffic verification test: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"sanity check"}' https://api.redwood/v1/tenant/myrion/invoke | jq '.status'` -> 200, latency 110ms
jessica (oncall): Monitoring metrics. Incidentbot: start rolling window checks.
incidentbot: Monitoring started: check_interval=30s, alert_on=5xx_rate>2%
omar (sre): initial telemetry: 5xx_rate dropped from 4.3% -> 0.6% in 3m. p50 latency down to baseline.
mike-myrion: Confirming our end: errors dropped, logs look normal. Thanks for fast response.
nina-cs: Sending update to Myrion support channel: "We observed a regression in a newly promoted artifact affecting canary traffic for Myrion. We've pinned to the previous stable artifact and are monitoring. We'll follow up with RCA."
jessica (oncall): On-call handover note: I'll stay until 19:00Z to ensure stability; Omar will create follow-up postmortem ticket and assign to eng-runtime and eng-ml for kernel regression.
eli-platform: Created ticket RDW-5782: investigate kernel regression/artifact art-20260310-37a9c. Tags: regression, canary, myrion, urgent.
sam-solutions: Recommend we schedule a controlled replay of longer-context requests against art-20260310-37a9c in staging with memory profiling.
omar (sre): Agree. Also suggest adding a canary-runbook step: automated perf smoke test for 20k tokens.
jessica (oncall): Great. Closing timeline: event start 18:12Z, mitigation applied 18:22Z, baseline metrics restored 18:25Z. Logging thread for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
